s: puM, (ni + ruDa + GaY .) nASaH । (yaTA, harivaMSe । 2 । 54 । “utpattiSca niroDaSca nityaM BUtezu pArTiva ! । fzayo'tra na muhyanti vidbAMsaScEva ye narAH ॥”) roDaH । iti medinI । De, 32 ॥ (yaTA, paYcatantre । 2 । 167 । “niroDAccetaso'kzARi nirudDAnyaKilAnyapi । AcCAdite varO meGErAcCannAH syurgaBastayaH ॥”) nigrahaH । iti hemacandraH । 6 । 144 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 6 । 60 । “indriyARAM niroDena rAgadbezakzayeRa ca । ahiMsayA ca BUtAnAmamftatvAya kalpate ॥”)
v: pu॰ ni + ruDa--BAve GaY । 1 nASe 2 gavyAdipratiroDe medi॰ 3 nigrahe ca tatra nASe (pralaye) “na niroDo na cotpattirna badDo na ca sADakaH । na mumukzurna vE mukta ityezA paramArTatA” sAM॰ pra॰ BA॰ DftA SrutiH । 4 nirudDAKyacittAvasTABede nirudDaSabde'sya svarUpAdikamuktam । “yogaScittavfttiniroDaH” pAta॰ sU॰ “anayordvayorekAgranirudDayorBUmyoryaScittasyEkAgratArUpaH pariRAmaH sa yoga ityuktaM Bavati ekAgre bahirvfttiniroDaH nirudDe ca sarvAsAM vfttInAM saMskAraSezARAM pravilaya ityanayoreva BUmyoryogasya samBavaH” BojavfttiH । tasya kAraRaYca tatra darSitaM yaTA “aByAsavErAmyAByAM tanniroDaH” pAta॰ sU॰ “aTAsAM niroDe ka upAyaH? iti cittanadI nAmoBavatovAhinI vahati kalyARyAya vahati pApAya ca । yA tu kEvalya prAgBArA vivekavizayanimnA sA kalyARavahA । saMsAra prAgBArA'vivekavizayanimnA pApavahA । tatra vErAmyeRa vizayasvotaH KilIkriyate vivekadarSanAByAsena vivekastota udGAwyate ityuBayADInaScittavfttiniroDaH” nA॰ । “aByAsavErAmye vakzyamARalakzaRe tAByAM prakASapravfttiniyamarUpA yA vfttayastAsAM niroDo BavatItyuktaM Bavati tAsAM vinivfttagAhyABiniveSAnAm antarmuKatayA KakAraRa eva citte SaktirUpatayA'vasTAnam । tatra vizayadozadarSanajena vErAmyeRa tadvEmuKyamutpAdyate । aByAsena ca muKajanakaM SAntapravAhapradarSanadvAreRa dfQasTEryamutpadyate । ityaM tAmyAM Bavati cittavfttiniroDaH” BojavfciH । “avAto viparItA । vivekaKyAtirityatastasyAM viraktaM cittaM tAmapi niruRadDi । tadavasTaM cittaM saMskAropagaM Bavati । sa nirvIjaH samADiH, na tatra kiYcit sampajYAyata ityasamprajYAtaH dviviDaH sa yogaScittavfttiniroDa iti । tadavasTe cetasi vizayABAvAt budDiboDAtmA puruzaH kiM svaBAvaH iti” pAta॰ BA॰ “ataScitiSakterviparIteti । yadA ca vivekaKyAtirapi heyA tadA kEva kaTA vfttyantarARAM dozabahulAnAmiti BAvaH । tatasyadvetorniroDasamADeravatAro yujyate ityAha atastasyAmiti । jYAnaprasAdamAtreRa hi pareRa vErAgyeRa viyekaKyAtimapi niruRadDItyarTaH । aTa anirudDA'SezavftticittaM kIdfSamityata Aha tadavasTamityAdi । sa niroDaH vyavasTA yasya tattaToktam । niroDasya svarUpamAha sa nirvIja iti । kleSasahitaH karmASayo jAtyAyurBonavIjam tasmAnnirgata iti nirDIjaH । asyEva yogijanaprasidDAmanvarTasaMjYAmAdarSayati na tatreti । upasaMharati । dviviDaH saHyoBaScittavfttiniroDa iti । saMpratyuttarasUtramavatArayaMScodayati । tadavasTe cetasIti । kimAkzepe tattadAkArapariRatabudDiboDAtmA tvayaM puruzaH sadAnumUyate natu budDiboDarahito'to'sya puruzasya budDiboDasvaBAvaH savituriva prakASaH na ca saMskAraSeze cetasi so'sti na ca svaBAvamapahAya BAvo varttitumarhati iti BAvaH । syAdetat saMskAraSezAmapi budDiM kasmAt puruzo na buDyate ityata Aha vizayABAvAditi । na budDimAtraM puruzasya vizayo'pi tu puruzArTavatI budDiH vivekaKyAtivizayamogO ca puruzArTO tO ca nirudDAsasTAyAM na sta iti sidDo vizayABAva ityarTaH” viva॰ । “tadA drazwuH svarUpe'vasTAnam” pAta॰ sU॰ “svarUpapratizWA tadArnI citiSaktiryaTA kEvalye, vyutTAnacitte tu sati taTApi BavantI na taTA” BA॰ “mUtreRa pariharatiM tadA drazwuH starUpe'vasvAnam । svarUpa ityAropitam SAntaDoramUQasvarUpaM nivarttayati । puruzasya hi cEtanyaM starUpamanOvAcikam । na tu budDiboDaH SAntAdirUpaH । copADikI hi saH, sPawikasyeDa svamAvasvacCaDabalasya japAkusumasanniDAnopADiraruRimA, na copAjinivfttAvupahitanivfttiratiprasaNgAditi BAvaH । svarUpasya cABede'pi BedaM vikalpya kaDikaraRaBAva ukta iti । ayamevArToBAvyakftA dyotyate svarUpapratizWeti । tadArnI niroDAvasTAyAM na vyutyAnAvasTAyABiti BAvaH । svAdetat vyutTAnAvasTAyAmapratizWitA svarUpe, citi SaktiH niroDAvasTAyAM pratitizWantI pariRAminI syAd vyutTAne vA svarUpapratizWAne sati vyutTAnaniroDayoraviSeza ityata Aha vyutTAnacitte tviti । na jAtu kUwasTanityA citiSaktiH svarUpAt cyavate । tena yaTA niroDe taTEva vyutTAne'pi । na Kalu SuktikAyAH pramARa viparyyayajYAnanocaratve'pi svarUpodayavyayO BavataH pratipattA tu taTABUtamapyataTAtvenABimanyate । niroDasamADimapekzya sampraprajYAto'pi vyutTAnameveti” vivaraRam 2 niruDyate yasmE sampradAne GaY । niroDajanite vaSIkaraRe ca “niroDaSCardiviDAraRAByAm” sAM॰ sU॰ “prARasyeti prasidDyA laByate “pracCarddanaviDAraRAByAM prARasyeti” yogasUtre BAzyakAreRa prARAyAmasya vyAKyAtatvAt । CardiSca vamanam, viDAraRaM tyAga iti yAvat । tena pUraRarecanayorlABaH । viDAraRaM ca kumBakam । taTA ca prARasya pUrakarecakakumBakEryoniroDo vaSIkaraRaM sA DAraRetyarTaH” sAM॰ pra॰ BA॰ ।
m: नि-˚रोध m. confinement, locking up, imprisonment (-तस्, Mn. viii, 375)
investment, siege, Cat.
enclosing, covering up, Var.; Kāv. &c.
restraint, check, control, suppression, destruction, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in dram.) disappointment, frustration of hope, Daśar.
(with, Buddh.) suppression or annihilation of pain (one of the 4 principles), Lalit.; MWB. 43, 56, 137 &c.
a partic. process to which minerals (esp. quicksilver) are subjected, Cat.
hurting, injuring (= नि-ग्रह), L.
aversion, disfavour, dislike, W.
N. of a man, Lalit.
a: निरोधः निरोधनं — 1 Confinement, locking up, imprisonment; Ms. 8. 310, 375. --2 Enclosing, covering up; Amaru. 87. --3 Restraint, check, suppression, control; योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः Yoga S.; Ku. 3. 48. --4 Hindrance, obstruction, opposition. --5 Hurting, punishing, injuring. --6 Annihilation, complete destruction. --7 Aversion, dislike. --8 Disappointment, frustration of hopes (in dramatic language). --9 (With the Buddhists) Suppression of pain.
